title: Per-Pixel Classification is Not All You Need for Semantic Segmentation (MaskFormer)
mechanism: Recasts semantic segmentation as predicting a set of binary masks each with one class label.
evidence: R: outperforms per-pixel baselines when the number of classes is large.
adaptation: Guides judgement: at 24 classes (13 with test support) little gain expected overall; judge mask classifiers on inactive and rare region classes, not on crack.
min_experiment: No own run; its question is answered by the M2F/EoMT arms (per-class comparison against house).
